hero.title: Less manual work. Clearer numbers. Better decisions.
hero.promise: I build software and AI automations that remove manual work and give growing businesses clear numbers.

problems.intro: Most growing businesses I meet have the same six problems.

items.quote: We type the same data again and again.
items.detail: Dispatch slips become invoices, POs go into your system, bills go into your books. All by hand.

items.quote: We don't know our real numbers until it's too late.
items.detail: Stock, sales, dispatch and dues sit in different registers and sheets.

items.quote: Everything happens on WhatsApp, and nothing is recorded.
items.detail: Orders, stock updates and production figures get lost in chats.
Nobody has a clear list of who owes what, or time to follow up.

items.quote: Our dealer or distributor network is hard to manage.
items.detail: Different price tiers, ledgers and orders, tracked across too many places.

items.quote: Every tool we try makes us change how we work.
items.detail: Off-the-shelf tools force workarounds. Software should fit your workflow, not the other way around.

process.detail: You walk me through how things work today. I mostly listen.
Clear scope, clear price, clear timeline.
You see a live demo every week and can change direction early.
I set it up, train your team, and stay on hand while everyone settles in.

nda: Happy to sign an NDA before we talk, if you'd like.

faq.q: Our team isn't very tech-savvy. Will this work for us?
faq.a: Yes. Everything works on a phone, with simple screens your team can learn in a day. I train everyone before launch.

faq.q: Do we have to replace our current software?
faq.a: No. I usually work with the data your software already exports, like Excel or CSV files, so you keep what you use today.
You do, always. With Own it, you also own the code from day one. With Subscribe, you can buy the code any time.

faq.q: What happens if we stop the subscription?
faq.a: You get a full export of your data. You can also buy the code and keep running it yourself.
Access is limited by role, everything is backed up, and I'll sign an NDA if you want one.
A pilot takes 30 days. Most full systems take 4–12 weeks, depending on what's included. Your fixed quote will say exactly.

faq.q: Which AI do you use, and who pays for it?
faq.a: I use the latest models from leading AI providers, picked for each task. You either pay the AI usage cost directly at actual cost, or choose a monthly plan that includes it up to a set limit.

faq.q: Can I see a demo built for my business before committing?
faq.a: Yes. I can build a working demo around your own process and data, so you see exactly how it would work for you. It's priced as a small share of the estimated project fee, confirmed on the call.

faq.q: Can you build an app for millions of users?
faq.a: That's not what I focus on. I build systems for businesses and their teams, dealers and customers, from a handful of users up to around 10,000. I can also build MVPs designed to grow to that size. That focus keeps your costs predictable and lets me support you personally. If you're building a mass-market consumer app, a larger team will serve you better, and I'm happy to point you to one.

cta.title: Let's talk
cta.summary: Tell me which part of your business takes the most time today. In 30 minutes, you'll know whether I can help and roughly what it would take.
cta.note: Need a website as well? Websites with lead capture are available alongside any of the services above.
